note: A PROPOSAL used only by the import lab to test how much accuracy a simpler component list would give. It changes nothing in the product. Set A keeps banner, media-beside-text and call-to-action apart; set B merges them into one section type with layout options.

navigation.description: Site or section navigation: top menu bar, side menu, breadcrumb trail.

footer.description: Page footer with link columns, contact details, legal line.

hero.description: Large opening banner: heading and text over or with a big image, video or slides.

split.description: Media beside text: an image or video on one side, heading, text and buttons on the other.

cta.description: Call to action: a short prompt with one or more buttons.

form.description: A form the visitor fills in: sign-up, contact, enquiry.

cards.description: A repeated set of similar items, each with an icon, image or video plus title, text and link, shown as a grid or a list.

feed.description: A list of dated posts, news or articles.

text.description: Plain running text or raw HTML content.

testimonials.description: Quotes from people: testimonials, reviews, a single pull quote.

logos.description: A row or grid of partner or client logos.

media.description: Stand-alone media: an image gallery or a video.

disclosure.description: Content revealed on demand: accordion or tabs.

tables.description: Tabular comparison: data table, pricing table or card, feature comparison.

article.description: Parts of an article page: article header, article body, author box.

contact.description: Contact details or a location map.

timeline.description: A sequence of dated or ordered events.
